stats.title: My watch statistics
stats.intro: Figures come from the daily roll-up: a viewing session is counted after it ends and the next aggregation runs, so the last hours may be missing.
stats.empty: No viewing recorded in this period
stats.allEmpty: No viewing recorded in this period for any user
stats.emptyHint: Statistics appear here after items are watched in a native app.
stats.timeZone: Days are counted in the {zone} time zone. Watch time excludes pauses, seeking and fast-forward.

export.heading: Export
export.hint: Downloads the daily rows (day, user, item) of the range shown. Large ranges may be refused; the export is recorded in the audit log.

clear.heading: Watch history
clear.hint: Only you and administrators can see your statistics. Clearing removes your progress, finished marks, counts and statistics on every device.
clear.done: Your watch history has been cleared.
